name: The Binding
statusNote: Unchanged in Forever as far as is known: the text, objectives and rewards below are Classic’s.
footerSourceNote: Text, givers, objectives and rewards come from the cMaNGOS Classic database (a reconstruction of the 1.12 world), with what Forever changed on top: the game server’s own answers where we have them, else Wowhead’s Forever database. Places are Classic’s, shown on the Forever maps. Quest text © Blizzard Entertainment.

narrative.details:
Surely you have seen the circle of summoning below us? Only there will you be able to draw forth an unbound voidwalker.

Using these runes, you will be able to draw it forth, and then you must dominate it through strength of arms and magic.

When it is subdued, it will be indentured to you. Come to me then, and I will elucidate the spell of summoning, so that it may serve you to whatever end you wish.
narrative.objectives: Using the Runes of Summoning, summon and subdue a voidwalker, then return the Runes of Summoning to Carendin Halgar in the Magic Quarter of the Undercity.
narrative.offerRewardText:
You have done well, adventurer. Now, I will impart to you the spell used for summoning the voidwalker.

The power that it unleashed upon you is now yours to command. Use it wisely.
narrative.requestItemsText: I expect to hear of your success, adventurer. Not meeting my expectations will be the least of your worries, however, should you fail.
